_about: Mo ta card cho cac khoi giao tiep module EHC (VPCL/FDCL/PLUL). DEF cua hang khong co chu cho cac khoi nay; tai lieu Toshiba 6F2K0653/6E2K0732 khong co tren may. 'quote' chep nguyen van tu DEHC Hardware Specification (chi noi lai cac tu bi ngat dong); 'role' la tom tat cua app dua tren ten chan va ban in logic EHC.pdf; 'quote_page' la so trang PDF dem tu 1. 'params' = y nghia tung tham so (nhan in canh gia tri tren ky hieu + than khoi trong TODEN.DEF); Help ghep them gia tri that cua khoi dang mo.

411E.role: CPU side of one VPCL01 valve control card. Which card it is comes from the station number (SN, parameter 2) and the I/O areas in parameters 3-7, not from the name in parameter 1 - that is only text, and all 10 VPCL blocks in the project carry the same name VPCL-01. It sends the card the valve position demand and the turbine trip, ICV close permit, TSV test and simulation commands, and reads back the valve position, position deviation, servo demand, servo current and a status word. The card reports three position channels (POS PRI, OTH1, OTH2), but the two other channels are marked NOT USED on all 8 EHC sheets. The position loop runs on the card, not in this block: servo demand = (position demand - position) x control gain, limited to +/-100 %, plus null bias (gain 20 and null bias 0 % in the EHC logic printout).
411E.quote: The Valve control module performs calculation of valve position from LVDT signal and output servo current to control valves. The demand of servo current is calculated by this module using valve position demand value from CPU modules. This module consists of a 3 KHz power supply for excitation of the linear voltage differential transformer (LVDT), LVDT demodulation and rectifier circuits, a power amplifier circuit to output servo currents, digital I/O circuit and so on. The module demodulates and rectifies valve position detection signals from LVDT and outputs valve opening signals.
411E.quote_from: Hardware Specification for DEHC (VP1-C-L2-I-CJJ-00003-AB0, doc 5G2K0883), section 2.4.4
more: card I/O: 1 LVDT input (+/-1 %FS, simulation input allowed), 1 servo current output (+/-33 mA/200 ohm, +/-66 mA/100 ohm or +/-200 mA/20 ohm), 2 DI, 5 DO - spec page 38

STATUS PACK bits as named on EHC.pdf page 111 (VPC-MSVA): 00 VLV FAST CLOSING, 01 ICV FAST CLOSING, 02 ICV CLOSING DEVIATION HIGH, 03 3kHz CMD PRI, 04 POWER AMP FAILURE, 05 POSITION QB, 06-07 POSITION QB of the other two channels (NOT USED), 08-09 CN DISCONNECT (the connector pair, and whether it is used, differs per valve), 10 SERVO DEMAND OFF, 11-15 NOT USED

EHC.pdf pages 111-118: the 8 EHC MODULE INTERFACE (VPC-...) sheets that use this block; the BFPT A and BFPT B databases also have a VPC-CV-A sheet with this block, set exactly like VPC-CVA in EHC MC (SN 93)
EHC.pdf pages 1446-1465: logic inside the card (VPCL01G011 Rev.4) - LVDT scaling and failure check, servo loop, fast closing on turbine trip / PLU operated, valve simulator
411E.params_note: All 7 parameters are 'tuning prohibited' in the vendor's macro_param.csv. The labels SN / DI / FI / DO / CO / FO are the ones printed next to the values on the symbol (EHC.pdf page 111); what each area holds comes from the block body 411E_I in TODEN.DEF. In this project the areas follow base = (SN - 30) x 100: DO / CO / FO at base and DI / FI at base + 50 (SN 81 -> RV5100 / IV5100 / AV5100 and RV5150 / AV5150) - a project convention, not a rule of the block.

params.what: Name text on the symbol (VPCL-01 in the project). Not used by the block logic, so it does not tell which card this is.

params.label: SN
params.what: Station number of the card, 1-250. Not used inside the block itself - the original software uses it when it builds the controller I/O. The VPCL01 front panel has STATION H / L switches (spec page 40), so this is most likely the number set on those switches.

params.label: DI
params.what: Command word sent TO the card: input pins 4-16 (3kHz PRI, ICV CLOSE PMT, TURBINE TRIP, TSV-1A / 1B / 2A / 2B TEST, SIM ON, SIM TRACKING, ON-OFF VLV, SPARE1 / 2, TR TRIGGER) packed into one 16-bit word; bits 13-15 are always 0.

params.label: FI
params.what: Values sent TO the card: input pins 1-3 POS DMD, POS DMD(SPEED), SERVO DMD(T)(%).

params.label: DO
params.what: Status word read FROM the card. Its bits are reordered onto output pin 32 STATUS PACK (bits 11-15 of STATUS PACK are always 0).

params.label: CO
params.what: Counts read FROM the card onto output pins 28-31: POS PRI, POS OTH1, POS OTH2, SERVO CUR (CNT).

params.label: FO
params.what: Values read FROM the card, in this order: POS PRI(%), POS OTH1(%), POS OTH2(%), SERVO CUR(%) (pins 24-27), POS (17), POS DEV (19), AFTER GAIN (22), BEFORE FX (23), SERVO DMD(%) (20), ICV CLOSE DEV (21), POS(SIM) (18).

411F.role: CPU side of one FDCL01 frequency detecting card. Which card it is comes from the station number (SN, parameter 2) and the I/O areas in parameters 3-6; parameter 1 is only text ("FDCL-" on every block in the project). It sends the card the speed-failure signal and two overspeed test commands, and reads back turbine speed and the overspeed set point (in % and in counts) plus a status word. Converting the pick-up frequency to speed and comparing it with the overspeed set point is done on the card, not in this block.
411F.quote: The Frequency detecting module performs monitoring the speed sensor signals and detection of Overspeed. This module also detects CPU module failure. This module mainly converts a sine wave (frequency signal) generated by an electromagnetic pick up installed to detect a turbine rotation speed to a digital signal as rotation speed, and sends it to a host CPU. The module also compares a specified overspeed set point and the turbine rotation speed, and outputs an alarm when the speed exceeds the specified set point.
411F.quote_from: Hardware Specification for DEHC (VP1-C-L2-I-CJJ-00003-AB0, doc 5G2K0883), section 2.4.2
more: in the project databases this block is used only on the BFPT A/B FDC-CA / CB / CC sheets; the EHC MC sheets use block 4102 (Frequency Digital Converter Module Interface) instead
EHC.pdf pages 1423-1432: logic inside the EHC unit's card (FDCL01G011 Rev.1) - 0-5760 Hz = 0-120 % speed, overspeed detection, CPU failure check; the BFPT card may be a different revision
411F.params_note: All 6 parameters are 'tuning prohibited' in the vendor's macro_param.csv. The labels are the ones on the symbol; what each area holds comes from the block body 411F_I in TODEN.DEF.

params.what: Name text on the symbol ("FDCL-" in the project). Not used by the block logic, so it does not tell which card this is.

params.label: SN
params.what: Station number of the card, 1-250. Not used inside the block itself - the original software uses it when it builds the controller I/O. The FDCL01 front panel has STATION H / L switches (spec page 33), so this is most likely the number set on those switches.

params.label: DI
params.what: Command word sent TO the card: input pins 1-3 SPEED FAIL, OVERSPEED TEST 1, OVERSPEED TEST 2 packed into one word.

params.label: DO
params.what: Status word read FROM the card. Its bits are reordered onto output pin 8 STATUS PACK.

params.label: CO
params.what: Counts read FROM the card onto output pins 6-7: SPEED(CNT), OVERSPEED SET(CNT).

params.label: FO
params.what: Values read FROM the card onto output pins 4-5: SPEED, OVERSPEED SET.

4126.card: PLUL01 power load unbalance detecting module
4126.role: CPU side of one PLUL01 power load unbalance card. Which card it is comes from the station number (SN, parameter 2) and the I/O areas in parameters 3-7; parameter 1 is only text (PLUL-01 / PLUL-02 in the project). It reads back generator current and load, reheat bowl pressure (own and two other channels), turbine power, power-load deviation, load decrease rate and a status word (PLU operated, P/L deviation high, load sudden decrease, signal quality, interface failure), and sends simulation values (generator current, reheat bowl pressure, SIM ON) and the transient-record trigger. The card computes load from generator current and power from reheat bowl pressure; when power minus load is high and the load drops suddenly it flags PLU operated and closes the valves through hard-wired signals to the VPCL cards.
4126.quote: The Power load unbalance detecting module performs detection of power load unbalance and output Valve close signals to Valve control modules by hardwired signals. To calculate generator load and turbine power, Generator CT signals and turbine reheat bowl Pressure signals are input to this module.
4126.quote_from: Hardware Specification for DEHC (VP1-C-L2-I-CJJ-00003-AB0, doc 5G2K0883), section 2.4.3
more: EHC.pdf pages 109-110: the EHC MODULE INTERFACE (PLUA, PLUB) sheets that use this block

EHC.pdf pages 1433-1445: logic inside the card (PLUL01G011 Rev.3) - load % from generator current, power % from reheat bowl pressure, P/L unbalance, P/L deviation high and generator load sudden decrease
4126.params_note: All 7 parameters are 'tuning prohibited' in the vendor's macro_param.csv. The labels SN / DI / FI / DO / CO / FO are the ones printed next to the values on EHC.pdf page 110; what each area holds comes from the block body 4126_I in TODEN.DEF.

params.what: Name text on the symbol (PLUL-01 / PLUL-02 in the project). Not used by the block logic, so it does not tell which card this is.

params.label: SN
params.what: Station number of the card, 1-250. Not used inside the block itself - the original software uses it when it builds the controller I/O. The PLUL01 front panel has STATION H / L switches (spec page 36), so this is most likely the number set on those switches.

params.label: DI
params.what: Command word sent TO the card: input pins 3-4 packed into one word.

params.label: FI
params.what: Values sent TO the card: input pins 1-2.

params.label: DO
params.what: Status word read FROM the card. Its bits are reordered onto output pin 20 STATUS PACK.

params.label: CO
params.what: Counts read FROM the card onto output pins 16-19.

params.label: FO
params.what: Values read FROM the card onto output pins 5-15, word order 5, 6, 13, 7, 14, 8, 15, 9, 10, 11, 12.
